name: Growth Engine
description: End-to-end revenue machine: content creation drives traffic, traffic converts to leads, leads close into deals. Each agent hands off context to the next.

team.description: End-to-end revenue machine: content creation drives traffic, traffic converts to leads, leads close into deals. Each agent hands off context to the next.

members.role: Strategic ideation — identifies what content will drive qualified traffic
Video production planning — turns ideas into video briefs and scripts
Distribution — publishes across platforms and monitors engagement
Intent capture — identifies buying signals and queues personalized outreach
Prospect discovery — finds ICP matches on LinkedIn and enriches profiles
Deal progression — moves stalled deals, drafts follow-ups, books meetings

sharedContext.description: Shared pipeline context: content performance feeds into prospect targeting, prospect signals feed into deal strategy.
